    11	constexpr int kN = 5000;
    12	constexpr int kDepth = 5;
    13	
    14	void DataSink(tapa::hls::stream<int>& data_in_q, int n) {
    15	  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    16	    data_in_q.read();
    17	  }
    18	}
    19	
    20	void DataSource(tapa::hls::stream<int>& data_out_q, int n) {
    21	  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    22	    data_out_q.write(i);
    23	  }
    24	}
    25	
    26	TEST(SimulateTest, SimulateHlsStreamHasInfiniteDepth) {
    27	  tapa::hls::stream<int> data_q;
    28	  DataSource(data_q, 10'000'000);
    29	}

    31	TEST(SimulateTest, SimulateHlsStreamCanBeNamed) {
    32	  tapa::hls::stream<int> data_q("data");
    33	  DataSource(data_q, kN);
    34	  DataSink(data_q, kN);
    35	}

    37	TEST(SimulateTest, SimulateHlsStreamCanBeInvoked) {
    38	  tapa::hls::stream<int> data_q("data");
    39	  tapa::task().invoke(DataSource, data_q, kN).invoke(DataSink, data_q, kN);
    40	}
    41	
    42	void DataSourceNonBlocking(tapa::ostream<float>& data_out_q,
    43	                           tapa::hls::stream<int>& count_out_q, int n) {
    44	  int write_count = 0;
    45	  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    46	    if (data_out_q.try_write(i)) {
    47	      ++write_count;
    48	    }
    49	  }
    50	  count_out_q.write(write_count);
    51	}
    52	
    53	void DataSinkNonBlocking(tapa::istream<float>& data_in_q,
    54	                         tapa::hls::stream<int>& count_in_q, int n) {
    55	  int read_count = 0;
    56	  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    57	    float value_unused;
    58	    if (data_in_q.try_read(value_unused)) {
    59	      ++read_count;
    60	    }
    61	  }
    62	
    63	  // Since `tapa::hls_simulate:task()` schedules tasks sequentially, we should
    64	  // only be able to read `kDepth` elements.
    65	  EXPECT_EQ(read_count, kDepth);

    68	  // count successfully.

    81	}
